action_instruction: Checking whether the order confirmation heading is present
intent: whether the order confirmation heading is shown

action_params.condition: The heading "Thank you, Demo! Your order is confirmed" is shown.
action_params.query: whether the order confirmation heading is shown
action_params.code_js: el(10).textContent.trim() === 'Thank you, Demo! Your order is confirmed'

action_instruction: Reading the order number from the confirmation message
intent: the order number in the confirmation message

action_params.condition: An Order number starting with "SF-" is shown.
action_params.query: the order number in the confirmation message

action_instruction: Reading the order total from the confirmation summary
intent: the order total amount in the order confirmation summary

action_params.query: the order total amount in the order confirmation summary

assertion_tree.description: The heading "Thank you, Demo! Your order is confirmed" is shown, an Order number starting with "SF-" is shown, and the "Order total" reads "$42.80".

assertion_tree.verification: The current page shows the specified confirmation heading, an Order number beginning with "SF-", and an "Order total" of "$42.80".
